answer: Before the stamp comes 26 letters of reference, each one priced at £49, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. One name, one proof, one entry: Millbound miller flour licence enforces it, and a licence millers carry after mill trials is how the check runs. A farm that mints names by the dozen still pays the toll name by name, and the velvet proves it. The clerk notes canyon. atlas stays on the record.
